## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

*Assuming general-market brand strategy for growth-stage companies (Seed–Series B, or bootstrapped equivalent); will re-anchor with $ figures once you name the vertical or client-size band.*

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Depth | Research thoroughness | Light (3 stakeholder interviews, no customer) / Standard (6 stakeholder + 3 customer) / Deep (10 stakeholder + 6 customer + audit) | Deep blocked at Sprint pace |
| Breadth | Brand-system scope | Verbal-only (positioning + messaging + voice) / +Naming / +Visual direction / Full system (verbal + naming + visual + rollout deck) | Naming requires Standard depth or higher; Visual direction requires Verbal foundation |
| Pace | Calendar timeline | Sprint (2 weeks) / Standard (6 weeks) / Extended (10 weeks) | Sprint blocked with Deep or Full system |
| Format | Working mode | Async-only / Hybrid (calls + async) / High-touch (weekly working sessions) | Async-only blocks Deep depth |
| Support | Revisions + post-delivery | 1 revision, no post / 2 revisions + 30-day async / Unlimited + 90-day embedded | Embedded requires Hybrid or High-touch |
| Handoff Readiness | Deliverable polish for downstream teams | Internal-only guide / Agency-handoff-ready packet / Full rollout (guide + handoff + internal enablement deck) | Full rollout requires +Visual or higher |
| Sector Specialization | Domain fluency applied | Generalist / Named sector focus | Named sector may cap concurrent engagements — pricing premium |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Sprint pace + Deep depth
- Sprint pace + Full system breadth
- Async-only format + Deep depth
- Naming add-on without at least Standard depth
- Embedded 90-day support without Hybrid or High-touch format
- Full rollout without at least +Visual breadth

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

| Tier | Configuration | Positioning | Pricing Logic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Lite — Positioning Sprint** | Light depth · Verbal-only · Sprint pace · Hybrid format · 1 revision · Internal-only | For founders who know they need clarity before their next launch/raise/hire but can't stall for 6 weeks. Positioning + messaging + voice in 2 weeks. | **+$A** (~40% of flagship). Anchored against the cost of shipping a website/deck with muddled positioning. |
| **Core — Brand Guide** *(flagship)* | Standard depth · +Visual breadth · Standard pace · Hybrid · 2 revisions + 30-day async · Agency-handoff-ready | For companies rebranding or launching who need a complete brand foundation their designer/agency can execute against. | **+$B** (current $15K anchor). Senior-strategist-only work at half the cost of a $25–50K agency engagement. |
| **Premium — Brand System + Embed** | Deep depth · Full system · Extended pace · High-touch · Unlimited + 90-day embedded · Full rollout · Named sector | For funded companies making brand a strategic bet — need naming, visual direction, internal rollout, and a strategist on-call through execution. | **+$C** (~2–2.5× flagship). Anchored below a consultancy retainer + naming project summed (~$45–60K market). |

### Build-Your-Own Framework

- **Base price:** +$A (Lite configuration)
- **Per-dimension upgrade pricing:** each level up on Depth, Breadth, Pace (Extended costs more, Sprint may cost more too for compression), Format, Support, Handoff Readiness, Sector Specialization adds an increment
- **Floor:** +$A — cannot configure below Lite
- **Ceiling:** if BYO configuration exceeds ~85% of Premium price, auto-route to Premium (better value + embed) or custom quote
- **Configurator must enforce:** all invalid combinations from Part 2, plus dependency chains (Naming → Standard depth; Embedded → Hybrid+; Full rollout → +Visual+)
- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO-summing to Core's exact configuration must price 15–20% above +$B; BYO-summing to Premium's exact configuration must price 20–25% above +$C. Flagships remain the rational discount — BYO is for buyers who genuinely want a non-standard shape, not a cheaper Core.

### Tier 2 — Signature *(Core, flagship)*

### Tier 3 — Elite *(Premium)*
- **Configuration:** Fully custom depth (with assessment) · Training + Nutrition + Habits · Weekly pace · Direct phone format · Unlimited form checks + on-demand adjustments · Meal-by-meal or full macros · Any goal including Event-prep
- **Positioning:** For clients with a specific outcome on a deadline — competition, wedding, medical driver — who need a coach available in real time.
- **Pricing:** `+$C/mo` — anchored below the sum of a 1-on-1 trainer + registered dietitian + accountability coach; positioned as concierge access.

- **Floor:** `+$A/mo` — cannot go below Foundation
- **Ceiling:** any BYO configuration summing above `+$C × 0.9` auto-routes to Elite (or custom quote if event-prep)
- **Configurator must enforce:** all dependencies in Part 2 table + invalid-combinations list
- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO-summing to Signature's config must price ~10–15% above `+$B`; BYO-summing to Elite's config must price ~15–20% above `+$C`. Flagships remain the rational discount for the intended client.
